description_en: Queries the historical report list for a specified application using a centralized role
description_zh: 中心化角色：查询指定应用历史报告列表
kebab_example: aliyun ebs list-reports --next-token a6792e832ff0XXXXX --max-results 10 --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-id app-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListReports

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return when using token-based pagination
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页模式查询时的页数
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html to query the regions supported by EBS Lens
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
